title: RuneScape Dragonwilds: How to DESTROY Kuldra Easy/Fast - Full walkthrough guide
author: dekafmusic
description: Here are some shortcuts I take to beat this boss #dragonwilds

transcript.text: I like to start every boss fight with Serge.
When you start the fight, rush to the crystal and get the dragon hasn't spawned yet. Use this
time to make an orb. Right after you activate the pylon, rush
back and make another orb.
The rest is easy. We only have to load the cannon and shoot the boss.
When starting the second phase, rush to the main area. This gives you space to dodge all the initial attacks.
Kill the dragon first. You need firema to activate the fire pilot.
Ignore the other dragon and focus on activating the air pylon. The Air Pylon requires an orb plus
airma. Make an orb before grabbing the airma. Hit the dragon when you can, but don't
kill it. We can use itsma to make an orb later.
You can carry the orb and thema at once. Do this to activate the air pylon. Now all pylons are activated. Start
making orbs for the cannon. Dragonma can be used to make orbs.
again. Rush to the main area to dodge the attacks.
Once the initial attacks are done, try collecting before the dragon spawns.
While waiting on the orb, kill a blue dragon. The water pylon requires an orb plusma to activate.
Looks like my orb disappeared. That's fine. We have two water dragons. We'll use the waterma to make an orb.
I'll kill this dragon forma and grab an orb to activate the water pylon on the same trip.
Now we need to activate the fire pylon. Thankfully, we don't need an orb, only firema from the fire dragon.
For the meantime, he'll make the orbs for the cannon water dragon again. I'll use itsma to make an orb.
Now we should have two orbs ready to use on the cannon after activating the fire pylon.
Finally a fire dragon.
The hard part is done. We already made two orbs. We only need to survive the attacks while loading the cannon twice.
Make sure you don't run out of stamina before jumping.
Once the boss is knocked down, we can enter through its mouth. Ignore the dragon.
The safest way to do this is with range. Make sure to dodge potion attacks.
Congrats. Now enjoy the reward.
